nodes.title: Good contraction G
nodes.statement: Some degree-4 nonroot has a simple contraction retaining a pair.
nodes.test: Extend the stated census or supply an arbitrary-size proof.

nodes.title: Two-sided lifting X
nodes.statement: A two-sided vertex has a nonexceptional tree matching in some contraction.
nodes.test: Extend the stated census or supply an arbitrary-size proof.

nodes.title: Exact Hall formulas
nodes.statement: Connected-complement deficiency G1 and contraction formulas G2,G3.

nodes.title: Four- and five-cycle obstruction
nodes.statement: Bad merges are exactly the stated four- or black-heavy five-cycle obstructions.

nodes.title: Coloured disk curvature
nodes.statement: 2 n4 >= 6 minus the number of boundary colour changes.

nodes.title: G without chordless five-cycles
nodes.statement: No separating triangle and no chordless five-cycle imply G.

nodes.title: Innermost descent fails
nodes.statement: Bad disks defeat inward descent at V=11; five-cycle and blocked-source refinements fail at V=13 and V=14.
nodes.lesson: Retain the witness and replace the refuted step, not the theorem.

nodes.title: Fixed-cover repair fails
nodes.statement: A fixed cover can contain a single tree matching, exceptional; V=18.
nodes.lesson: Retain the witness and replace the refuted step, not the theorem.

nodes.title: Corner avoidance
nodes.statement: Every bounded black face has at least two values across the tree matchings.
nodes.test: Extend the stated census or supply an arbitrary-size proof.

nodes.title: New census
nodes.statement: Hall formulas through V=14; short-cycle structure through V=19; X probes through V=18.
